task: Production incident: customers are charged but orders remain PENDING after payment webhook delivery.

messages.content: I will start from the incident logs, then inspect the webhook handler and order store.
The handler only processes event.type === 'payment.succeeded' before calling orders.markPaid(orderId, paymentId).
markPaid transitions PENDING orders to PAID and avoids duplicate paid history entries.
Updated the webhook handler so payment.captured uses the same paid transition as payment.succeeded, while preserving duplicate delivery idempotency.
